name: tiddlydnd-plugins
description: Plugin bundle for the DnDWiki repo family: dndwiki-core (format layer), dndwiki-forgottenrealms (Forgotten Realms calendar data, optional) and staticfiles (dev server assets). Includes a minimal edition for the boot/smoke check (npm run smoke), a functional test (npm test) and a language pack check (npm run check-lang).
